meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 CDP 协议操控你电脑上的 Chrome 浏览器，复用已有的登录状态，自动打开网页、等待加载、执行 JavaScript、截取页面快照，并提取登录令牌等认证信息。
howto.when: 当你说需要控制 Chrome 浏览器进行自动化操作，或提到“浏览器操作”、“Chrome CDP”等关键词，以及要求复用登录态、提取登录令牌时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开这个网页，并提取里面的登录令牌。
用浏览器自动化点击页面上的登录按钮。
say.note: Claude 会截取交互元素快照并执行点击。

say.text: 复用我 Chrome 的登录态，抓取当前页面文本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control Chrome via CDP, reuse existing login sessions, open URLs, wait for page load, run JavaScript, take snapshots, and extract auth tokens from the browser.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate Chrome, reuse a login session, or mention keywords like 'browser automation', 'CDP', or 'extract token from browser'.

say_en.text: Open this URL and extract the login token from it.
say_en.note: Claude opens the page via CDP and reads localStorage or cookies.

say_en.text: Click the login button on the page using browser automation.
say_en.note: Claude takes an interactive snapshot and performs the click.

say_en.text: Reuse my Chrome login and scrape the current page text.
say_en.note: Claude connects to the debug port and runs JavaScript to get the body text.
